protocol.scope: CPU profiles start after harness setup and stop immediately after ESM import or CJS require. resolveThemeTokens receipt runs after profiler stop.
protocol.matrix: theme-core and compatibility theme; ESM and CJS; exact Node v22.0.0 and current Node
protocol.warmup: One fresh-process warmup per matrix cell, excluded from aggregate
protocol.retainedSamples: Fifteen fresh processes per matrix cell
protocol.sampleTime: Profiler timeDeltas are diagnostic CPU sample intervals in microseconds; loadMs is diagnostic wall time and is never compared with an approved budget.
protocol.sourceMaps: Maps come from the same source revision and production entry config. Source attribution is allowed only when normalized default and diagnostic generated JavaScript hashes match.
